headline: AB Enzymes anti-staling launch; cocoa-saving replacers multiply; Barry Callebaut sales fall 15%
summary: AB Enzymes launched Veron MaxiFresh, an amylase anti-staling enzyme, a direct competitor move against Puratos freshness ranges; get the spec and benchmark it.

Cocoa-saving products are multiplying: Planet A Foods' cocoa powder replacer, RFINE's coffee-based KAFFIKA cocoa extender and pladis's accelerator call for cocoa alternatives are all partner or competitor signals for Belcolade.
Barry Callebaut reported full-year sales down 15% while pushing its new fermentation platform, which may open customer and pricing room for Belcolade.
Clean-label mould inhibition and shelf life were a recurring trade-press theme, a chance to position Puratos fermentation-based preservation with US bakers.
Regulatory: FDA approved three more natural colour additives and WHO proposed an ultra-processed food profiling model, both pushing customers toward reformulation Puratos can support.
